study.question: Does the conditional loss from randomizing the relative ranks of the two greatest-index full blocks arise during learning, at inference, or through train/eval mismatch, given the inherited shuffled older-block summary and supplied-order pooling?
study.hypothesis: Observed A00=0.6684321265491402 and A11=0.6671566369200901 differ by -0.0012754896290501 at equal32192421 parameters. Within-block-only AUC=0.6681562512315359 and joint pair/within AUC=0.6669768476662585 suggest pair-rank availability is more consequential in this seed, but simultaneous train/eval treatment cannot distinguish learning effects from evaluation perturbation. If useful pair-rank associations must be learned, training-only randomization should remain worse under supplied evaluation (A10<A00); if inference sensitivity dominates, restoring supplied evaluation may substantially recover that loss. These are provisional competing predictions, not a confirmed mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text236-283 gives target-conditioned unnormalized pooling and reports a null LSTM attempt on its own data. We preserve the inherited adapted pooling and inspect phase-specific conditional order dependence. Its external sequential null does not transfer here; this is neither a DIN reproduction nor a new attention mechanism.

Pinned benchmark source144-169 explicitly splits recent/earlier histories and projects them into tokens. We add no queries, learned mixing or partition architecture. We condition on two supplied-index full blocks and separate when an existing perturbation is active. No original-paper equivalence or priority claim.

Keep the exact inherited pair and older-block permutation implementation, summary transport and learned computation. Add only independent training/evaluation activation flags; original code used one flag for both phases.

Inherited custom context-gradient routing and all source/normalization/config choices; they are held fixed and receive no new mechanism claim
Newest-two full-block selection, older-block shuffling, complete-event destination-to-source maps, match-union inverse transport and isolated evaluation RNG

study.proposed_difference: Two standalone files add independent terminal_pair_train_shuffle and terminal_pair_eval_shuffle booleans; the learned computation and all permutation generators are unchanged. Both new files build all inherited maps in both phases. Only selection of the summary map depends on model.training. The existing same-seed A00/A11 receipts complete the factorial, conditional on host parity checks; no duplicate training of those known cells is requested.
predictions: A01-A00 measures evaluation-only sensitivity on the A00 training recipe; it is not alone evidence of useful order under retraining.
A11-A01 measures the effect of training with swaps when evaluated with swaps. Positive values suggest adaptation; randomization may also regularize.
A10-A00 measures training with swaps under supplied pair ranks at evaluation; A11-A10 measures evaluation perturbation after such training.
Report interaction (A11-A10)-(A01-A00), alongside all four cells and the matched-retraining gap A11-A00; do not assume additive AUC effects.

Both variants retain32192421 total parameters (31793216 embedding,399205 dense), pending host measurement. Paired identical-training paths should have identical initial weights and same train-mode outputs/gradients/RNG under matched input and state.

Pure eval-only perturbation should leave predictions exactly unchanged for histories with fewer than two full blocks when compared at the same weights/state, including empty histories. Retrained models need not have identical untreated-slice outcomes.
falsifiers: Failure of bijection, mask/padding/event association, current-target exclusion, phase routing, RNG or parity gates invalidates the implementation before scientific interpretation.
If A10 matches or exceeds A00 and the loss occurs chiefly in A11-A10, reject the provisional claim that the observed terminal gap principally reflects failure to learn useful rank associations.
If A01 matches A00, reject inference sensitivity as the sole explanation for a reproduced A11 deficit; investigate training dynamics instead.
If A11 improves over A01 and reaches A00 within measured uncertainty in an admissible repeated comparison, reject a persistent utility penalty from this conditional order removal.
One fixed seed and no user-cluster intervals cannot justify significance, repeated support or a general mechanism claim; absent authorized repetition the conclusion remains preliminary.
alternative_explanations: Inference distribution shift, random channel noise and Dice running-statistic mismatch
Optimization or implicit regularization from stochastic training maps rather than useful chronology
Finite-seed and finite-evaluation-map variation; batch-position dependence of the inherited isolated evaluation RNG
Supplied-index proxy features, benchmark static snapshots and offline feedback visibility; no timestamps or elapsed-time effects are identifiable
Interactions with inherited summary bottlenecks, compression and surrogate gradients rather than an intrinsic property of event order

contrasts.intervention: Complete a 2x2 factorial of terminal pair permutation at training (T) and evaluation (E). A10 terminal_pair_train_only and A01 terminal_pair_eval_only are new; A00=g2-r0089-summary_terminal_bridge and A11=g2-r0089-summary_terminal_pair_shuffle are committed matched controls. Axy denotes click AUC, not an additive model of predictions.
contrasts.control: Use existing A00 and A11 only after exact source, initialization, forward/loss/backward and RNG parity gates on the host. New A01 training must match A00; new A10 training must match A11. These same-seed executions are paired contrasts, not independent repetitions.

remaining_confounds: Only a conditional summary path is perturbed; supplied-order compression and ten-event group membership remain available.
A10 tests a train/eval mismatch as well as learned robustness; A01 tests a mismatch as well as rank sensitivity. The interaction is descriptive, not unique attribution to information loss.
AUC is nonlinear; factorial differences are contrasts of population AUC, not a mechanistic decomposition of model scores.
Evaluation perturbations are fixed by inherited batch position/shape. One map and one training seed cannot establish population-average stochastic performance or significance.
Inherited bf16 arithmetic, Dice running statistics, shared training and surrogate gradients can propagate changes into untreated and empty-history slices.

Prior diagnostics are not_requested: treatment integrity and population movement have not been measured in those receipts. Failure of new gates invalidates reuse; it is not scientific counterevidence.
contrasts.decision_if_supported: If evaluation-only loss A01-A00 is larger in magnitude than retrained loss A11-A00, and retraining improves randomized-evaluation A11-A01, report adaptation to distribution shift. If A10 remains below A00 under supplied evaluation and A11 remains below A00, record preliminary conditional evidence that training without pair ranks is costly; retain stochastic optimization/regularization alternatives. Reserve follow-up resources rather than expanding architecture search.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If A10 recovers A00 while A11 is lower, prioritize inference perturbation or mismatch over a learning-utility interpretation. If the A00/A11 gap does not survive valid comparable execution, withdraw the stronger conditional explanation. A null under this localized treatment does not refute global order utility. Do not select or assess using withheld outcomes.
